title: HD 11964: a certified no-orbit-crossing time for a real exoplanet system
note: Side campaign (lemma.farm). Planar Newtonian three-body model of HD 11964 (star, planets c and b; Rosenthal et al. 2021 catalogue data, minimum masses, coplanar). Route: certified drift of the semi-major-axis actions from approximate integrals checked against the original Hamiltonian, then exact angular-momentum conservation, the LP lane's first-exit lemma and LP0 give no orbit crossing for |t| <= T. Target rung: T = 10^3 yr. The application package applications/hd11964 is opt-in and never part of KAM-dev's default build. The orchestrator updates this file when a stage completes; weights are the stages' relative effort.
